author: Stimulating
body:
Soup PvP With A Twist

One Gamemode would be 1v1 PvP like a soup server except with full Diamond Armor (and a Full Iron one if we want as well) and Wood Swords/Tools so you PvP as long as you would on a Soup Server except you don't have to micromanage health and hotkey which takes some of the complication out of soup PvP and allowing you to focus more on your PvP in-game. IMO this would appeal to a larger audience.

Regular Soup PvP

Also I think a soup PvP gamemode would draw in more players to Avicus and build upon the competitive scene on the server and we could set up tournaments for these modes as well.  

Avicus EU 


An EU Server would get us more visitors and give us more of a global presence as a server.

replies.author: cinammoncroc000
replies.body:
I love Soup PvP. We'd have to make some creative twist, or else it'd probably end up being some P2W thing like most servers with Soup/Kit PvP.

A server for EU would be nice, but we don't have a big enough playerbase to have it effectively. Also, the cost to have an EU server on top of a US server would be... well... enormous, I guess.

I never said the server needed saving or am trying to 'save the server', I just think the addition of the game modes would help avicus's player count, people are just on less because of school. The server doesn't need saving but I know that tons of people on avicus would love soup and pot PvP, more traffic is a bonus. If you want to take a positive topic that's about improving the server and make wild assumptions about it and make it have a down feel to it post it somewhere else. And reality check...

 The server doesn't need saving. 

Thanks
